For each of the next 10 overtime hours, she is paid at a rate which is 50% higher than her regular rate. For each of the next 6 overtime hours, she is paid at a rate which is 75% higher than her regular rate. How much can Mary earn in a week if she works the maximum number of hours?
John drove to a distant city at 60 mph. On the return trip, he averaged 12 mph faster. If the outbound trip took 53 minutes, how many miles was the trip one way?
Olivia was buying DVDs of her favorite TV series. Each season had 8 DVDs. If she bought 6 seasons and also got a bonus disc set with 5 extra DVDs, how many DVDs did she have in total?
David obtained 61 marks in English, 97 in Mathematics, 82 in Physics, 67 in Chemistry, and some marks in Biology. His average marks are 72. What are his marks in Biology?

Julie works at a restaurant that pays her an hourly rate of $5. She works 8 hours a day. Her monthly salary was $2120, but she was not able to go to work for a day that month. How many days did she work that month?
In an election between two candidates, the winning candidate received 100% of the votes polled, defeating the other by a majority of 53 votes. What was the total number of votes polled?

Two dogsled teams raced across a certain distance in Wyoming. Team A finished the course in 0.53 fewer hours than Team W. Team A's average speed was 5 mph greater than Team W's, and Team W's average mph was 20. What was the distance of the course?
The farmer had 141 apples. He gave 88 apples to his neighbor. How many apples does he have now?
Tim had some money. He paid 40 cents for a candy bar and got 13 cents as change. How much money did Tim have initially?

Nhai employs some men to build a highway of 2 km in 50 days working 8 hours a day. In 25 days, they completed 1/4 part of the work. Nhai needs to hire 53 more employees to finish it in time working 12 hours a day. How many men were initially employed by Nhai?
Sum of the squares of 3 numbers is 1209 and the sum of their products taken two at a time is 800. Find the sum?

Bailey has a budget of $1370 to buy new towel sets for her home. She needs to buy 2 new sets of towels for the guest bathroom, 4 new sets for her master bathroom, 3 sets of hand towels for the powder room, and as many kitchen towel sets as possible without exceeding her budget. The set of towels for the guest bathroom are $40.00 each, the master bathroom set is $50.00 each, the hand towel sets are $30.00 each, and the kitchen towel sets are $20.00 each. The store is currently offering 20% off on the master bathroom sets, 15% off on the guest bathroom and hand towel sets, and a 10% discount on the kitchen towel sets. Bailey also needs to pay a sales tax of 8% on the discounted prices. Given her budget, how many sets of kitchen towels can Bailey buy after purchasing the required sets for the other areas and taking into account the discounts and sales tax?
Jack collects baseball and football cards. He has 69 cards total. The number of baseball cards he has is five more than three times the number of football cards. How many baseball cards does he have?
If the personal income tax rate is lowered from 40% to 33%, a taxpayer with a certain annual income before tax has differential savings of $3.71. What is the taxpayer's annual income before tax?
Jamal had a bag of marbles with different colors. He had 3 blue, 3 green, and 1 black marble. The probability of drawing a black marble is 1/60. How many yellow marbles does he have in the bag?
The sides of a triangle are in the ratio \(53 : 40 : 11\) and its perimeter is 104 cm. What is the length of the longest side?
What is the least value of x so that a certain number multiplied by x is divisible by 53? The number is 2 and the answer is 53.
If 60% of 3/5 of a number is 19.08, what is the number?
If the simple interest on a certain amount at 8% rate for 5 years amounted to Rs. 31.8 less than the principal, what was the principal?

In a sample of 1000 high school students, all are either freshmen, sophomores, juniors, or seniors. There are 40 juniors and 10 seniors. There are 10 more freshmen than sophomores. What percentage of the students are not sophomores?
When 53 moles of NaCl react with excess KI to form KCl and NaI in a 1:1 mole ratio, how many moles of NaI are formed?
What is the area of a triangle with a base of 10.6 m and height of 10 m?
The 3rd and 5th terms of an arithmetic sequence are 15 and 34, respectively. What is the 7th term of the same sequence?
After a visit to the newly opened aquarium, 47 percent of the aquarium visitors fell ill from a mysterious disease. If there were 100 visitors, how many of them did not fall ill?
Kevin has a tree growing in his garden that is currently 954 inches tall. That is 50% taller than it was when he planted it there. How tall was the tree, in feet, when he planted it?
Today, David, who is 77 years old, and his daughter, who is 12 years old, celebrate their birthdays. How many years will pass before David’s age is twice his daughter’s age?
There are 8 blue balls and 5 red balls in the box. When 45 blue balls are added to the box, how many blue balls are in the box?
Allen is 13 years younger than his mother. In 3 years, the sum of their ages will be a certain number. The present age of Allen's mother is 30. What will be the sum of their ages in 3 years?
The area of a square is equal to the area of a rectangle whose width is 53 cm. The perimeter of the square is 212 cm. What is the length of the rectangle?
What is the positive difference between the \(100^{\mathrm{th}}\) term and the \(153^{\mathrm{rd}}\) term of the arithmetic sequence \(1, 2, 3, 4, \ldots\)?

Jenna is on a road trip. She drives for 5 hours at 60 mph, takes a bathroom break, and then continues driving for 9 hours at 55 mph. She can drive for 30 miles on one gallon of gas. If one gallon of gas costs $2, how much money does she spend on gas for her trip?
The mean proportional between 212 and a number is 106. What is the number?
Walking at 50% of his usual speed, a man takes 53 minutes more to cover a distance. What is his usual time to cover this distance?

Gretzky Street begins at Orr Street and runs directly east for 18.9 kilometers until it ends when it meets Howe Street. Gretzky Street is intersected every 350 meters by a perpendicular street, and each of those streets other than Orr Street and Howe Street is given a number beginning at 1st Street (one block east of Orr Street) and continuing consecutively (2nd Street, 3rd Street, etc.) until the highest-numbered street one block west of Howe Street. What is the highest-numbered street that intersects Gretzky Street?
Given that \((18^a)(9^{3a-1})(3^a) = 2^{53} \cdot 3^{475}\), where \(a\) is a positive integer, what is the value of \(a\)?

While preparing balloons for Eva's birthday party, her mom bought some balloons and 1700cm³ of helium. One balloon needs 50cm³ to float high enough to touch the ceiling, and she can fill any remaining balloon with ordinary air. She used up all of the helium and inflated every balloon. There are 15 more balloons touching the ceiling than not. How many balloons did Eva's mom buy?
Jack received 24 emails and 64 letters in the morning. He then received 29 emails and 54 letters in the afternoon. How many emails did Jack receive in the day?
There are 122 colored lights on a Christmas tree. Some of them are red, 37 of them are yellow, and 32 of them are blue. How many red lights are there on the Christmas tree?
Some less than 4 times 20 equals 27. What is the subtracted number?
Given that a^2 + b^2 + c^2 = 183 and a + b + c = 17, what is the value of ab + bc + ca?

A farmer estimates that he will harvest some bushels of wheat. The weather is perfect during the growing season, so he harvests 84 bushels of wheat more than expected. The farmer harvested 137 bushels of wheat. How many bushels of wheat did the farmer initially estimate he would harvest?

Sally sold 10 cups of lemonade in the first week at $1 per cup. In the second week, she sold 100% more lemonade at a price of $1.25 per cup. In the third week, she sold 20% more lemonade than the first week at a price of $1.50 per cup. What was the total revenue Sally earned from selling lemonade in all three weeks?
The sum of two numbers is 54, and their difference is 52. What is the product of the two numbers?

The average salary of a person for the months of January, February, March and April is Rs. 50 and that for the months February, March, April and May is Rs. 55. If his salary for the month of May is Rs. 73, find his salary for the month of January?
If the radius of a round pancake is 26.5 centimeters (cm), how many centimeters (cm) is the diameter of the pancake?
What is the dividend if the divisor is 19, the quotient is 2, and the remainder is 15?
Rowan can row a certain distance downstream in 2 hours. Returning upstream it takes 5 hours to complete the trip. His rate in still water is 18.55 kilometers per hour. How far can he row downstream?

The Vance family walked over to the post office. They bought some rooster stamps and 53 daffodil stamps. The difference between the number of the two kinds of stamps is 0. How many rooster stamps did they buy?

Mary works in a restaurant a maximum of 60 hours per week. For the first 40 hours, she is paid $0.50 per hour. For the next 10 hours of overtime, she is paid $1.00 per hour. If she works beyond 50 hours but less than or equal to 60 hours, she is paid $2.30 per hour. What is the maximum amount Mary can earn in a week?

In a collection, there are some stamps. 30 are foreign and 25 are more than 10 years old. If 12 stamps are both foreign and more than 10 years old, and 10 stamps are neither foreign nor more than 10 years old, how many stamps are in the collection?

Lilith is trying to break the world record for largest cap collection. She collects 3 caps per month in the first year, and 5 caps per month after the first year. Each Christmas, she also receives 40 caps from friends and family. She estimates that each year, she loses 15 of the caps she has collected. Lilith has been collecting for a certain number of years and has collected 4481 caps so far. How many years has she been collecting caps?

A whale feeds for 9 hours. In the first hour it eats 20 kilos of plankton. Each hour after that, it eats a constant amount more than the previous hour. If the total consumed over the 9 hours is 2088 kilos, and the whale eats 285 kilos in the sixth hour, how many more kilos does it eat each hour compared to the previous hour?
At the carnival, the ratio of people who won the ring toss game to those who lost it was 4:1. If 212 people won the game, how many people would have lost?
Let \(z\) and \(w\) be complex numbers such that \(|z| = 7\) and \(|w| = 60.\) Find the smallest possible value of \(|w - z|.\)
A car travels 39.75 km uphill at a certain speed and then 60 km downhill at 60 km/hr. If the average speed for the whole trip is 57 km/hr, what is the speed of the car when it travels uphill?
There were seventy people on the train. After the first stop, seventeen people got off the train. How many people were left on the train after the first stop?

Mitch is a freelancer, she works 9 hours every day from Monday to Friday and 2 hours every Saturday and Sunday. If she earns $1 per hour and earns double on weekends, how much does she earn every week?

A farmer plants his vegetables in neat rows. He has 64 bean seedlings and plants 8 seedlings in a row. He also has 84 pumpkin seeds and plants 7 seeds in a row. Recently, he planted 106 radishes in 2 rows. The farmer plants two rows per plant bed and he had 14 plant beds for all his plants. How many radishes did the farmer plant in each row?
Paige’s dresser has 3 drawers that each hold 15 pieces of clothing, and she also has a shelf that holds 8 more pieces. How many pieces of clothing can she store in total?
Jackson takes a day off every 8 days. He also takes 8 extra holidays during the year. How many total days off does he take in a year?
A sugar solution of some liters contains 55% sugar. If 2 liters of water are added, the new solution has 53% sugar. What was the initial volume of the sugar solution?
The average weight of some persons increases by 2 kg when a new person comes in place of one of them weighing 65 kg. The weight of the new person is 171 kg. How many persons were there initially?

John can complete a given task in 3180 days. Jane takes fewer days to complete the same task. They set out to complete the task by working together. However, Jane was indisposed 8 days before the work got over. The work got over in 60 days from the time they started to work on it together. How many days does it take for Jane to complete the task alone?
The length of the bridge, which a train 322 metres long and travelling at 45 km/hr can cross in 30 seconds, is ?
In the first 20 overs of a cricket game, the run rate was only 0.4. The run rate should be 1.5 in the remaining 30 overs to reach a certain target. What is the target number of runs?

Thomas has 120 drawings to display. 30 of the drawings were made using colored pencils. 20 of the drawings were made using blending markers. 10 of the drawings were made using pastels and 7 of the drawings were made with watercolors. The rest of the drawings were made with charcoal. How many are charcoal drawings?
Michael has some fish. Ben gives him 18 more fish, and now Michael has 71 fish. How many fish did Michael have initially?
10.6% is 20% of some percent. What is the initial percent?

A chemistry lab can be used by 83 students at one time. The lab has 16 work-stations. Some set up for 2 students and the others set up for a certain number of students. If there are 15 work-stations that accommodate 2 students, how many students can be accommodated at the other work-station?

Eight dots are placed on the circumference of a circle such that exactly 3 of the possible triples form equilateral triangles. How many combinations of three dots can we make from these 8 dots that do not form an equilateral triangle?

Pipe A can fill a tank in 54 minutes. Pipe B can fill the same tank some times faster than pipe A. If both pipes are connected to the tank so that they fill the tank simultaneously, it takes 1 minute for the empty tank to overflow. How many times faster can pipe B fill the tank compared to pipe A?

Stacy went to a store to buy some pairs of shorts. Each pair normally costs $20, but there's a discount of 53% on the total cost for people who purchase 5 or more pairs at once. How much can she save by buying 5 pairs at once as opposed to purchasing them individually at different times?
If \( x = 53 - 30t \) and \( y = 40t - 3 \), then \( x = y \) when \( t = 0.8 \). What is the constant in the equation for \( x \)?

In one month in the Smith house, Kylie uses 12 bath towels and 10 hand towels, her 2 daughters use a total of 30 bath towels and 40 hand towels, her husband uses a total of 20 bath towels and 14 hand towels, and her 3 sons use a total of 88 bath towels and 120 hand towels. The washing machine can fit 5 bath towels or 8 hand towels for one load of laundry. Assuming bath towels and hand towels cannot be washed in the same load, how many loads of laundry will the Smiths need to do to clean all of their used towels?

In a school, the largest class has 105 students, and each subsequent class has 2 fewer students than the previous one. The total number of students in all classes is 2809. How many classes are there in the school?

Sarah had 3 pages of math homework, 5 pages of reading homework, and 3 pages of science homework. If each page of math and reading had 4 problems, and each page of science had 7 problems, how many problems did she have to complete in total?
A triangle has a base of 53 centimeters and a height of 2 centimeters. Find the area.

For Gwen's birthday, she received:  
- 5 dollars from her dad  
- 10 dollars from her mom  
- 8 dollars from her uncle  
- 3 dollars from her aunt  
- 6 dollars from her cousin  
- 61 dollars from her grandparents  

Gwen then spent:  
- 4 dollars on a toy  
- 7 dollars on a book  
- 5 dollars on a movie ticket  

How much more money did Gwen receive from her grandparents than from her uncle?

Isabella and Alexis went to the mall to buy some pants and dresses. Alexis bought 3 times more pants and dresses than Isabella. If Isabella bought a total of 25 pairs of pants and dresses, and Alexis bought 22 pairs of pants, how many dresses did Alexis buy?

John raises emu. He has some pens for emu and each pen has 6 emus in it. Each female emu lays 1 egg per day. Half the emu are females, so he gets 1113 eggs a week. How many pens for emu does John have?

Two trains are moving in the same direction. The slower train travels at 35 km/h. The faster train crosses a man in the slower train in 12 seconds, and the length of the faster train is 60 meters. What is the speed of the faster train?

Oliver uses a bucket that holds 1 gallon to fill his bathtub. He fills it 60 times to reach the top and then takes away 7 buckets to get to the level he uses for his baths. He takes a bath once a week. How much water does he use each week?
Carol and her mom were picking carrots from their garden. Carol picked 29, and her mother picked 48. If only 24 of the carrots were good, how many bad carrots did they have?
How many moles of HCl are formed when 53 moles of NaCl react with 53 moles of HNO3 to form 53 moles of NaNO3, if the moles of HCl are equal to the moles of NaNO3 produced in the reaction?

A train covers a distance in 60 minutes, running at an average speed of some kmph. To reduce the time of the journey to 53 minutes, the train must run at a speed of 60 kmph. What is the current average speed of the train?

A bucket full of nuts was discovered by the crow living in the basement. The crow eats \( \frac{2}{53} \) of the total number of nuts in 8 hours. How many hours in total will it take the crow to finish a quarter of the nuts?
Luke was putting his spare change into piles. He had 13 piles of coins. Each pile had 4 coins, except one pile had 5 coins. In total he had _____ coins.

Sofia asked the students to suggest specific types of food. 408 students suggested adding mashed potatoes while some students suggested adding bacon to the menu. There were 355 more students who suggested mashed potatoes than those that suggested bacon. How many students suggested adding bacon?

When Nathan is cold, he adds an extra blanket to his bed. Each blanket warms him up by a certain number of degrees. One night, he was cold enough that he added half of the 10 blankets in his closet on his bed. The blankets warmed Nathan up by 265 degrees. How many degrees does each blanket warm him up?
Today is my birthday, and my age is 13 less than twice the age I was 20 years ago. What is my age?
Carol collects some peanuts. Carol's father gives Carol 5 more peanuts, and now Carol has 58 peanuts. How many peanuts did Carol collect initially?
Find the cost of fencing around a circular field of a certain diameter at the rate of Rs. 1.50 a meter. The total cost of fencing is Rs. 249.7566159603882. What is the diameter of the field?
A tank is filled by using a 5-liter bucket 10 times and then a 3-liter bucket once. What is the capacity of the tank?
A boy runs at a constant speed of 15 mph for 8 hours and then increases his pace and covers the next 855 miles at an average speed of 19 mph. Find the total duration of his running.
Tapanga and Corey have some candies together. Tapanga has 11 more candies than Corey, and Corey has 21 candies. How many candies do they have together?
Martin owns a farm with 20 hens. These hens lay 80 eggs in 10 days. Martin decided to buy some more hens. All hens will lay 438 eggs in 15 days. How many more hens did Martin buy?

In a sample of 600 high school students in which all students are either freshmen, sophomores, juniors, or seniors, 27 percent are juniors and 75 percent are not sophomores. There are 85 seniors. How many more freshmen than sophomores are there among the sample of students?

On rainy mornings, Mo drinks exactly n cups of hot chocolate (assume n is an integer). On mornings that are not rainy, Mo drinks some cups of tea. Last week Mo drank a total of 529 cups of tea and hot chocolate together. During that week, Mo drank 1 more tea cup than hot chocolate cups. There were 2 rainy days last week. How many cups of tea does Mo drink on mornings that are not rainy?
For a birthday party, Cody bought 7 regular sodas and some diet sodas. If his fridge would only hold 6 on each shelf, he filled up 10 shelves. How many diet sodas did he buy?

Darryl sells melons on the side of the road. He sells cantaloupes for $2 each and honeydews for $3. He started the day with 75 cantaloupes and 27 honeydews. He accidentally dropped a couple of cantaloupes and three of the honeydews turned out to be rotten. At the end of the day he had a certain number of cantaloupes and 9 honeydews left. He made $85. How many cantaloupes did he have left at the end of the day?

A football team shares a single water cooler during practice. Linemen get the first water break and will drink a certain amount of ounces each. Skill position players get the second water break and drink 6 ounces each. The team has 12 linemen and 10 skill position players. The cooler holds 666 ounces of water. 5 skill position players must wait for the cooler to be refilled before they can get a drink. How many ounces do linemen drink each?
Sam had 98 pennies in his bank. He spent some of his pennies and now has 45 pennies left. How many pennies did he spend?
Nancy's old washing machine could only wash 8 pieces of clothing at a time. If she had to wash 120 shirts, 80 sweaters, 150 pairs of socks, and 74 pairs of jeans, how many loads would she have to do?
a is some years older than b who is twice as old as c. The total of the ages of a, b, and c is 103. b is 20 years old. How many years older is a than b?

A car is driving through a tunnel with many turns. After a while, the car must travel through a ring that requires a total of 4 right-hand turns. After the 1st turn, it travels 5 meters. After the 2nd turn, it travels 7 meters. After the 3rd turn, it travels a little further and at the 4th turn, it immediately exits the tunnel. If the car has driven a total of 65 meters around the ring, how far did it have to travel after the 3rd turn?

Mcdonald is planning to open up a farm that provides eggs to the community. In his local community, Saly needs 40 eggs, Ben needs 60 eggs, and Ked needs half of the number of eggs needed by Ben per week. Additionally, Rachel requires 1.5 times the number of eggs Saly needs, and Tom needs 75 eggs every week. Taking into account that a hen can lay an average of 5 eggs per week, calculate the number of hens Mcdonald needs to maintain on his farm to fulfill the community's egg requirements for a month which has 4 weeks.
John plays at the arcade for some hours. He uses $.50 for every 6 minutes. He spent $265. How many hours did he play at the arcade?
There are 50 houses in a block, and there are 3 blocks. A mailman has to give 1 piece of mail to each house, but he already gave out 97 pieces. How many more pieces does he need?
A regular pentagon has each side measuring 10.6 cm. What is its perimeter?
Joshua has some Skittles and 6 eggs. If he shares the Skittles among 5 friends, each friend gets 10 Skittles, and Joshua keeps 3 for himself, how many Skittles does Joshua have?

How many moles of Potassium hydroxide are required to react with 53 moles of Hydrochloric acid at a temperature of 100°C and concentrations of 2 M for both solutions, while maintaining a constant pressure of 1 atm, to form 53 moles of Water along with 53 moles of Potassium chloride?

Chandra has one bowl and 53 glasses, each a different color. If she chooses a bowl and a glass from the cupboard, how many pairings are possible?

Harkamal purchased 3 kg of grapes at the rate of 11 per kg and 4 kg of mangoes at the rate of 5 per kg. How much amount did he pay to the shopkeeper?

If x = 150 + 2q and y = 44 + 4q, then for what value of q is x equal to y?

The sum of the integers from 26 to 27 inclusive is how much?

A fifth-grade class of 10 students went on a field trip to the zoo, and their class merged with another class of 36 students. 5 parents offered to be chaperones, and 2 of the teachers from both classes were also present. At noon, a group of 15 third-grade students and 3 more chaperoning parents arrived at the zoo as well. When the school day was over, 10 students from both fifth-grade classes and 6 from the third-grade class chose to go home. Among them, 2 parents left as chaperones. How many individuals were left at the zoo?

Mike bought a DVD of his favorite movie. He paid some amount for it at the store. A friend of Mike's, Steve, saw this and also decided to buy a DVD of the movie, but it was already sold out. He needed to order it online, which cost him twice as much as Mike paid. And in addition, he needed to pay the shipping costs which were 50% of the price of the film he ordered. Steve paid $159 to get the DVD in total. How much did Mike pay for the DVD at the store?
John has a party and invites 265 people. Of the people he invited, 20% didn't show up. 75% of the people who show up get steak and the rest get chicken. How many people ordered chicken?
While bird watching, Gabrielle saw 66 birds total. Chase saw 1 robin and 1 blue jay, and some cardinals. Gabrielle saw 20% more birds than Chase. How many cardinals did Chase see?

Mrs. Gable’s third grade class is on a field trip to the beach. For lunch, Mrs. Gable brought lunches for the students in her class. She included a pack of animal crackers in each lunch bag for dessert. Each pack of animal crackers contained 10 animal crackers. If 2 students did not eat their animal crackers, 510 animal crackers were eaten in total among Mrs. Gable’s students. How many students are in Mrs. Gable's class?

On Monday, while at work on the farm, Jeremy picks 10 oranges. On Tuesday, together with his brother, they pick thrice as much. On Wednesday he feels tired and is only able to pick 13 oranges. What's the total number of oranges they have?
Sandy's goal is to drink 13.25 liters of water in a day. She drinks 500 milliliters every 2 hours. After how many hours will she be able to drink a total of 13.25 liters of water?
Vincent bought 10 books about animals, some books about outer space, and 3 books about trains. Each book cost $16. Vincent spent $1056 on the books. How many books about outer space did Vincent buy?

Molly spends a certain amount per package to send Christmas gifts to her relatives by mail. She has two parents and three brothers, and each of her brothers is married with 2 children each. She sends one package to each relative by mail, and it costs her $742 to send all of the gifts by mail to her relatives. How much does it cost her per package to send the gifts?

Zoe needs to make 5 brownies for a party, each requiring 12 cups of flour. She already has 7 cups. How many more cups does she need?

Fresh grapes contain 60% water by weight while dried grapes contain 20% water by weight. What is the weight of dry grapes available from 106 kg of fresh grapes?

Jo has given Aiden at least one toy car every birthday. The number of cars has corresponded to Aiden's age (one car for his first birthday, two cars for his second birthday, and so on) except that on his 10th birthday, Jo gave him only 8 cars instead of 10. After receiving the cars for his 10th birthday, how many total toy cars will Aiden have received from Jo?

0.75 of a number is 39.75. What is the number?
